title: Hsinchu County's Accessible Environment Construction Achievements Shine, Wins National Land Agency's Special Excellence Rating Again, Top Among Non-Six Major Cities
summary: Hsinchu County's efforts in building accessible environments have yielded impressive results, earning a special excellence rating from the National Land Agency for consecutive years and ranking first among non-six major cities.
body:
